single_core_variable: availability and organization of prior user-state evidence at 50-turn scale

uruha_memory.description: Actual UruhaBrain checkpoint runtime over an isolated external-memory database; RightBrain local model loading disabled as in V2.17.
uruha_memory.history_access: bounded working memory plus retrieved episodic/profile memory
uruha_memory.generator_boundary: qwen2.5:7b planning plus UruhaBrain deterministic surface and guards

plain_recent.description: Direct qwen2.5:7b chat with the same visible Uruha persona/output contract and only the previous eight dialogue turns.
plain_recent.history_access: recent eight turns, no external memory

plain_full.description: Diagnostic direct qwen2.5:7b chat with the same visible Uruha persona/output contract and the complete prior transcript.

interpretation_rules: A correct string is not source-grounded recall unless the condition actually received the source or UruhaBrain trace shows it entered decision.
If plain_recent lacks the source and explicitly abstains, record epistemic safety rather than hallucination; it may still lack task utility.
If uruha_memory and plain_full both answer correctly, claim persistence/compression/traceability relative to bounded context, not better reasoning than an LLM.
If plain_full matches or beats uruha_memory, do not claim answer-quality superiority from external memory.
Architecture cost is part of the result; this full-system comparison is not token-parity and cannot isolate intelligence.
Automatic anchors measure factual state tracking only; naturalness, felt understanding, and overall preference require blind human ratings.

claim_boundary.reason: It extends the same preference-revision family used to develop V2.17, while changing values, length, and relational distractors.
